_readme.what: The real food and drink offer of the club's cafe and restaurant, for the Elite Nutrition pillar. Every entry carries its source. Nothing here is invented; what could not be read or found is listed under gaps.
_readme.status: overall state: 'partial' = no complete menu is published anywhere we can reach; two prices and the grab-and-go fridge come from the club's own footage, the four coolers from the club's own news post.
_readme.checkedAt: date of the last check, YYYY-MM-DD.
_readme.sources: every place a fact came from: id, kind (page, rest-json, footage, firecrawl, search-snippet), url or file, when checked, one-line note. Items point to these ids.
_readme.categories: groups used on the page: id, name (the club's wording where the club has one), source.
_readme.items: one record per named food or drink. name = as the club writes it. description = club wording only, otherwise null. price = the number exactly as the club prints it (null when none is visible); priceDisplay = the club's own format string; currency = 'IDR (assumed)' when the club prints no unit; priceUnitConfirmed = false until Raoul or the club confirms. dietaryTags only if the club states them (none do). status: footage-verified | online-verified | footage-name-only | online-name-only. source = where it was read (footage entries give file and second). verifiedOnline = true only if the name is on a club web page.
_readme.bowl: the 'create your own bowl' step flow as the club defines it. null = the club defines no steps anywhere we can reach (see bowlReport).
_readme.bowlReport: why bowl is null, what was searched, and what exists instead (photos only).
_readme.fridge: the GRAB N' GO fridge: name as printed, where it stands, which item ids it holds, what could not be read.
_readme.drinks: ids of the items in items[] that are drinks (cross reference, no duplicate records).
_readme.dietitian: the dietitian offer as published: text as published, how to ask, source.
_readme.gaps: everything missing or contradictory, with what would close it.
_readme.rules: do's and don'ts for the page: what must not be shown or claimed.

sources.note: 1080x1350 walkthrough. TV menu board at 14.25-15.5 s, GRAB N' GO fridge at 15.5-16.5 s, counter with standee and printed menus at 6.25-7.95 s. Evidence frames in _build/menu-frames/.
Dish close-ups at 14.3-14.9 s (no text): a plated omelette-style dish, a chocolate shake, a tiramisu shake, steak and eggs. Not named, not used as items.
Captions 'Work together' (about 30-33 s) and 'Eat together' (about 33-34 s) over cafe and restaurant shots; end card lists PERFORM, EAT, RECHARGE, WORK above BETTER TOGETHER. No menu content.
Read with Firecrawl (1 credit). Pages modified 2026-10-01. Cafe, restaurant, co-working inclusion; 'F&B prices are subject to tax and service'; member quotes about the food.
WordPress REST JSON (page modified 2026-09-17) and the Firecrawl copy of 2026-10-01 held by the v2.1 sourcing. Restaurant in the facility list, dietitians on request, 'excl. treatments and F&B'.
WordPress REST JSON (modified 2026-09-17). 'Coffee & Protein bar' is a facility with a four-photo slider (two smoothie bowl photos); no text, no menu.
News post dated 2024-08-01 (WordPress REST JSON). Names four coolers; 'You can order the coolers in the restaurant, the cafe, or on Gojek'. No prices. Two years old.

The club's own Gojek link from the coolers post. Listing 'Elite Fit Bali Restaurant & Bar, Mengwi', categories 'Kopi, Minuman, Barat'. The menu itself is inside the Gojek app only; the GoFood web page returned a 403 block (no workaround tried).
WordPress REST JSON (modified 2024-11-08). 'No outside food or drinks are allowed on the premises.'
All 556 media items listed and searched for menu, food, drink, bowl, cafe: no menu image or PDF exists. Cafe and restaurant photos (2026-09-14) and two smoothie bowl photos (2024-01-03) exist.
Index, page, post and archive sitemaps read (Firecrawl failed twice on the XML, so plain curl for the sitemap files). No menu, cafe, nutrition or food page exists.
Only the search-result text, no Instagram page was opened: 'The Common x Elite Fit Bowl ... Buy 1 Get 2 Elite Fit Day ...' (a 2024 partner promotion). Not verified, not used.

bowlReport.summary: The club publishes no 'create your own bowl' (no steps, no options, no prices) on any page, post, media file or footage we can reach. The structure base, protein, toppings, sauce comes from Raoul's brief, not from a club source, so it cannot be shown as the club's menu.
searched: all pages, posts and archives in the sitemap (page, post, post-archive, trainers, schedule, members): no menu, cafe or nutrition page
full text of every page and post via WordPress REST JSON: no 'bowl' except the two smoothie bowl photo names
all 556 media items: no menu image, no PDF; only two smoothie bowl photos (2024-01-03)
Header-Portrait.mov 6-17.5 s, every 0.25 s at full resolution: the TV board shows two specials only; the printed menu on the counter is unreadable
Header-Video-Landscape.mov and the reel: no menu board
GoFood listing: the menu is in the Gojek app only (web page blocked)
one web search (5 results): an Instagram snippet about a 2024 partner bowl ('The Common x Elite Fit Bowl'), a fixed bowl with a day-pass offer, not a build-your-own
bowlReport.whatExists: Two club photos of a smoothie bowl (strawberry slices, banana, almonds, coconut flakes, granola, chia, mint) on the Coffee & Protein bar slider of /perform/. They show what a bowl looks like, they are not a list of options.
bowlReport.toClose: A photo of the cafe's printed menu (the white sheet and the black card lying on the counter) or the Gojek menu screens, taken by Raoul as a member. With that, 'bowl' is filled and the flow lights up without code changes.

rules: Show a price only for steak-and-eggs and tiramisu-shakes, and only after GAP-03 is answered; every other item is shown without a price ('Prices at the cafe').
Never show an item, option, step name or price that is not in this file. The four bowl steps from the brief are not the club's.
Never quote the board's description or nutrition figures, or the 2024 post's health claims.
Never show the ARTUGO mark, other brands' labels, or the Instagram partner promotion.
No order, no payment, no account: the action is 'Ask at the cafe' or a WhatsApp message.
